name: Gems: rarer, and yours
what: Every gem source cut to a quarter (gem bag drops 1 in 1,500 to 1 in 6,000 skilling, 1 in 150 to 1 in 600 kills, bosses 1 in 5 to 1 in 20; gems off ore 3% to 0.75%; the monsters and Captain Claw’s chest that drop them too). Gems can’t be traded between players or listed, bid for or bought on the Exchange; the Gem Sorter still buys them. Gem offers already up come down once at start, held for their owners. Bronny’s keystone stops asking for gems.
ships: flip HOLD.gemcut to false with the rest of v1.1; the rules, the wiki and the page, then the worker (gems.js, index.js). One number to tune: GEM_CUT (0.25).
